ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat (ALPHV/Noberus) pre-encryption recovery inhibition + safe-mode reboot chain
ucs.description: Hunts the BlackCat affiliate playbook of staging encryption by setting Safe Mode with Networking via bcdedit, deleting Volume Shadow Copies via vssadmin/wmic, and clearing Windows event logs via wevtutil — the documented Rust-locker handoff sequence (per Microsoft Threat Intelligence and Mandiant tracking of Noberus). Two or more of these LOLBin actions on the same host in a 30-minute window is the actor's fingerprint, not a generic ransomware template.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND Processes.process="*safeboot*") OR (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=wevtutil.exe AND (Processes.process="*cl *" OR Processes.process="*clear-log*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name _time span=30m | stats dcount(Processes.process_name) as distinct_actions values(Processes.process_name) as actions values(cmdlines) as cmdlines min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by Processes.dest Processes.user | where distinct_actions >= 2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot")
   or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
   or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
   or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "cl " or ProcessCommandLine has "clear-log"))
| summarize DistinctActions = dcount(FileName),
            Actions = make_set(FileName),
            CmdLines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
  by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 30m)
| where DistinctActions >= 2     // 2-of-4 destructive-recovery actions in 30m = BlackCat handoff sequence
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where (ProcName == "bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "safeboot")
   or (ProcName == "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "shadows")
   or (ProcName == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
   or (ProcName == "wevtutil.exe" and (CommandLine has "cl " or CommandLine has "clear-log"))
| summarize DistinctActions = dcount(ProcName),
            Actions = make_set(ProcName),
            CmdLines = make_set(CommandLine),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
  by Computer, Account, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where DistinctActions >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SAFEBOOT*)) OR (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* OR *ShadowCopy* OR *SHADOWCOPY*) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete* OR *DELETE*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"cl "* OR *clear-log* OR *Clear-Log*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/safeboot/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)shadowcopy.*delete", field=CommandLine))
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(cl\s|clear-log)/i)
| bucket(span=30m, field=@timestamp, function={ groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function={ count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=DistinctActions) | collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine]) }) })
| DistinctActions >= 2
ucs.rationale: The 2-of-4 LOLBin combo (bcdedit safeboot + vssadmin shadow delete + wmic shadowcopy delete + wevtutil log clear) within a tight time window is the exact pre-encryption sequence Microsoft documented for the BlackCat Rust locker and the affiliate playbook tracked by Mandiant as Noberus. Individual actions fire on every legitimate admin script; the 30-minute correlation and 2-distinct-action thresho

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat (ALPHV) Rust locker execution via distinctive --access-token CLI arguments
ucs.description: Hunts execution of the BlackCat ransomware binary itself by detecting its hard-coded CLI flags (--access-token followed by a 32+ char hex configuration token, --no-prop-servers, --propagated, --child) — these are required arguments the Rust locker validates at startup, so absence means the binary won't decrypt its config, making this a near-zero-FP detection of BlackCat regardless of file name (locker.exe, c.exe, .pre files, renamed under any path).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_path) as image from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*--access-token*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-servers*" OR Processes.process="*--propagated*" OR Processes.process="*--child --access-token*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | where match(cmdline, "(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{40,}") OR match(cmdline, "(?i)--no-prop-servers") OR match(cmdline, "(?i)--propagated") OR match(cmdline, "(?i)--child\s+--access-token") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--no-prop-servers", "--propagated", "--child")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{40,}"
     or ProcessCommandLine has "--no-prop-servers"
     or ProcessCommandLine has "--propagated"
     or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--child\s+--access-token"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession=tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession)
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where CommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--no-prop-servers", "--propagated", "--child")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{40,}"
     or CommandLine has "--no-prop-servers"
     or CommandLine has "--propagated"
     or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--child\s+--access-token"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, SubjectUserName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat (ALPHV/Noberus) Ransomware Binary Execution via Distinctive CLI Flags
id: 8c5f5a1a-9d2e-4f74-9c0c-b2c3e5d6a7b0
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of the BlackCat/ALPHV Rust-based ransomware binary based on its required runtime CLI flags (--access-token <hex>, --no-prop-servers, --propagated, --child --access-token). The binary will not decrypt its embedded JSON configuration without --access-token, making this a high-fidelity signature regardless of file name.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/06/13/the-many-lives-of-blackcat-ransomware/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/noberus-ransomware-blackcat
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1027
  - detection.threat_hunting
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{40,}'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '--no-prop-servers'
      - '--propagated'
  selection_child_token:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)--child\s+--access-token'
  condition: selection_token or selection_flags or selection_child_token
falsepositives:
  - None known — these flag combinations are specific to BlackCat/ALPHV
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@CommandLine:*--access-token* OR @CommandLine:*--no-prop-servers* OR @CommandLine:*--propagated* OR @CommandLine:*"--child --access-token"*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine=/--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{40,}/i
  OR CommandLine=/--no-prop-servers/i
  OR CommandLine=/--propagated/i
  OR CommandLine=/--child\s+--access-token/i
| table([_time, aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData, ParentBaseFileName])
ucs.rationale: The Rust-based BlackCat/ALPHV/Noberus locker requires --access-token <32-byte hex> at the command line to derive the AES key for its embedded JSON config; without it the binary aborts. --propagated/--child/--no-prop-servers are the affiliate-deployment flags used when pushing via PsExec/Impacket-WMI to peer hosts. This combination is documented by Microsoft Threat Intelligence and Mandiant as Blac
